profile.headline: Front-End Web Developer | React · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS · .NET
profile.location: San Juan de los Lagos, Jalisco, México

summary.short: Front-End Web Developer with 4+ years of experience building responsive, user-focused web and mobile interfaces with React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript, backed by hands-on .NET REST API development.
summary.long: Front-End Web Developer with 4+ years of experience designing and building responsive, accessible web and mobile interfaces for inventory, fleet-control, and patient-scheduling platforms across México and the United States. Specializes in React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript, paired with Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap to deliver clean, maintainable, component-based UI systems, and complemented by practical .NET, ASP.NET Core, and REST API experience for full-stack collaboration. Combines a strong eye for web and interface design with a detail-oriented, collaborative approach, consistently shipping production-ready front ends that turn complex business workflows into intuitive user experiences.

workExperience.location: San Juan de los Lagos, Jalisco, México
responsibilities: Developed and maintained enterprise web applications as the dedicated front-end specialist over a 2.5-year tenure, crafting exceptional user interfaces with JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Bootstrap
Translated business requirements and UI/UX designs into responsive, cross-browser interfaces, applying web and interface design best practices
Built reusable, component-based React architectures that improved UI consistency and accelerated delivery of new features
Collaborated on-site with cross-functional teams to ship, test, and continuously improve production front ends
Developed the front-end of an inventory management web platform remotely for a U.S.-based distribution company
Built responsive, type-safe interfaces with TypeScript and Bootstrap to ensure a consistent user experience across devices
Delivered inventory views and data-entry forms that streamlined stock tracking workflows
Delivered front-end interfaces for a cross-platform inventory system spanning web (React) and mobile (React Native) applications, working fully remotely
Built responsive UI components and integrated REST APIs to support real-time inventory workflows
Partnered with the team across time zones to ship and refine features for warehouse operations
Built a web application to control vehicle entry and exit within the institute as part of a development-cell project
Developed the front-end interfaces with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for access-control and monitoring workflows
Collaborated within an academic development team to deliver a functional institutional system
Built a web application to manage patient records and appointment scheduling for an optical clinic
Developed responsive front-end interfaces with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap to digitize daily clinic operations
Implemented data and appointment management views that replaced manual patient tracking
